lines.text: از خانه یا از شرف یا از مثلثه طبع خویش بدان ستاره دهد که بدو پیوندد دفع تدبیر ستاره
lines.en: from its domicile, or from its exaltation, or from the triplicity of its nature, to that planet which joins it. The repulsion of the management of a planet

lines.text: زود رو بستاره دیر رو پیوندد و تدبیر خویش بدو دهد مسئله دیگر هر گه که پیشی درجه از ان
lines.en: is when a fast-moving planet joins a slow-moving planet and gives its management to it. Another problem: whenever the degree of the former is

lines.text: ستاره کمتر بود که بدو خواهد پیوست ماه را ذاهب گویند یا اتصال انستاره و اگر درجه
lines.en: less than the planet to which it will join, the Moon is called departing, or the application of that planet. And if the degree of

lines.text: هر دو یکی باشد حقیقت آمیزش باشد و اگر ماه از ستاره شش گانه دور شده باشد منصرف
lines.en: both is the same, it is the truth of the mixture. And if the Moon has moved away from the planet by six degrees, it is separating.

lines.text: گویند وحشی السیر آن بود که بیک شبانروز بهیچ ستاره پیوندد و وحشی السیر آن بود که او
lines.en: They say that the wild-moving is that which in one day and night joins no planet, and the wild-moving is that which

lines.text: روز بهیچ پیوندد و ناگاه او را اتصال پیدا شود و قران قتاب ده اجماع گویند
lines.en: in a day joins nothing, and suddenly an application appears for it. And the conjunction of the Sun is called the assembly,

lines.text: و مقابله استقبال پس دایره اینست
lines.en: and the opposition is the reception. So the circle is this:

lines.text: باب بیستم در معرفت رباط کواکب و خفی و پری زحل چون پیش از افتاب برآید مشرقی گویند
lines.en: Chapter Twenty: On the knowledge of the stations of the planets, and the hidden and the full. Saturn, when it rises before the Sun, is called eastern.

lines.text: و چون از پس افتاب فرورود مغربی و چون میانه او و افتاب بیست درجه بماند ناپدید
lines.en: And when it sets after the Sun, it is western. And when between it and the Sun twenty degrees remain, it becomes invisible.

lines.text: شود و چون افتاب از او بیست درجه بگذرد پیدا شود و از میان او و افتاب صدو
lines.en: And when the Sun passes it by twenty degrees, it appears. And from between it and the Sun one hundred and

lines.text: بیست درجه بگذرد مستقیم شود و چون صدو بیست درجه گذشت راجع شود تا افتاب
lines.en: twenty degrees pass, it becomes direct. And when one hundred and twenty degrees have passed, it becomes retrograde until the Sun

lines.text: بصد و بیست درجه اورسد مستقیم شود مشتری چون میان او و افتاب پانزده درجه
lines.en: reaches one hundred and twenty degrees from it, it becomes direct. Jupiter, when between it and the Sun fifteen degrees

lines.text: بماند ناپدید شود و چون از افتاب پانزده درجه بگذرد پیدا شود و چون از افتاب صدو
lines.en: remain, becomes invisible. And when it passes the Sun by fifteen degrees, it appears. And when from the Sun one hundred and

lines.text: و بیست درجه بگذرد راجع شود و چون افتاب بصد و بیست درجه اورسد مستقیم شود
lines.en: twenty degrees pass, it becomes retrograde. And when the sun reaches one hundred and twenty degrees from it, it becomes direct.

summary.headline: Planetary Stations and Applications
summary.text: Astrological rules for planetary application and separation, including the Moon departing, wild-moving planets, solar conjunction and opposition, followed by Chapter Twenty on planetary stations, visibility, eastern and western rising, and retrogradation, with examples for Saturn and Jupiter.
